h: Seyi Vodi reportedly turned away by bouncers at Zlatan Ibile's wedding
p: Content creator Seyi Vodi was reportedly denied entry to Zlatan Ibile and Davita's wedding by security staff, and Nigerians have reacted online. It is not clear whether he had an invitation. Many other stars attended the celebration.
more: Davido and Enioluwa were among the guests.
Videos from the wedding continue to circulate online.
